links.comparator_used: Direct answering of the underspecified query, and rephrasing the same query without acquiring new patient information, across five language models
links.outcome: Diagnosis retrieval (exact Top-1 accuracy, selective exact Recall@5) and dietary-safety classification (accuracy, MCC)
links.effect: Diagnosis retrieval: overall exact Top-1 accuracy up by at least 57.1 percentage points and selective exact Recall@5 up by at least 77.7 percentage points across five models vs direct prompting. Dietary-safety: accuracy improved in all five models and highest MCC in four.
